settings.title: Why Most Business TikTok Accounts Go Nowhere

settings.html:
You post a few times, get no traction, and give up. TikTok rewards consistency and strategy, not one-off effort.

Your content looks like it was filmed on a Tuesday afternoon with no plan. Good content starts with a hook and a brief.

You're spending hours creating content that your competitor's agency produces in a system, every week, without fail.

That's the gap we close.

Content Strategy

Monthly content pillars, hook research and a content calendar built around what your audience is already searching for on TikTok.

Filming

We come to you. Product shoots, behind-the-scenes, team content, drone footage for businesses where aerial adds impact.

Editing

Professional cuts with trending audio, subtitles, colour grading and pacing built for TikTok's algorithm.

Posting

We post at the right time for your audience, with captions, hashtags and location tags optimised per post.

Community Management

Replies, comments and DMs handled within 24 hours to keep your engagement rate healthy.

Monthly Reporting

Views, reach, followers, engagement rate and what we're changing next month.

settings.title: How We Run Your TikTok Every Month

settings.html:
1

Strategy Session

Month one: we map your audience, competitors, content pillars and first 30 days of hooks. Ongoing: we review what worked and adjust.

2

Content Brief

A shot list and script outline for the month, sent to you before we film so you know what to expect.

3

Film Day

We come to your location for a half-day or full-day shoot depending on your package. We bring the equipment.

4

Edit and Schedule

All content edited, subtitled and scheduled into a monthly content calendar for your approval before anything posts.

5

Post, Engage and Report

We post on the approved schedule, manage engagement daily and send a performance report at the end of the month.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: Do we need to be involved in the filming?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: For the Starter package, you provide the footage. For Business and Growth, we handle the filming. You need to be available on shoot day (or have a team member there for context), but you don't need to be on camera unless you want to be.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: What if TikTok doesn't work for our industry?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: TikTok works for almost every industry when the content is right. The platform rewards useful, interesting or entertaining content, not just dance videos. We have run successful accounts for trade businesses, service companies and B2B brands. We do honest onboarding: if your industry genuinely isn't a good fit, we'll tell you before you sign.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: How long before we see results?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Most accounts see meaningful reach growth within 60 to 90 days of consistent posting with a solid strategy. Follower growth follows reach. Patience and consistency are the only formula that works.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: Do you post on other platforms too?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts are available as add-ons. We reformat the content for each platform rather than cross-posting the same file.
You do. Every video file is downloaded and stored in a shared Google Drive folder under your account. We post with access you grant us, and you can remove that access at any time.
No penalty, no cancellation fee. We wrap up at the end of the billing month, send you all the files and hand over access. Everything we built stays with you.
